title: Satisfaction gives way to alarm
odia:
ଘର ବର ଦେଖି ପେଟ ପୂରୁଚି
ସଉତୁଣୀ ଦେଖି ହଂସା ଉଡୁଚି।
literal_meaning: Seeing the house and bridegroom, my belly fills; seeing the co-wife, my spirit flies away.
meaning_odia: ଘର ଓ ବରକୁ ଦେଖି ସନ୍ତୋଷ ହେଉଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ସଉତୁଣୀକୁ ଦେଖି ଭୟ ଲାଗୁଛି। ଏଠାରେ ଆନନ୍ଦ ଦେଉଥିବା ଦିଗ ସହିତ ଚିନ୍ତା ଜନ୍ମାଉଥିବା ଅନ୍ୟ ଦିଗଟି ମଧ୍ୟ ରହିଛି। ଏହା କଥକଙ୍କ ମିଶ୍ର ଅନୁଭବର ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠ।
explanation: The first sight brings satisfaction; the second unsettles it. Read editorially, the couplet captures an attractive situation whose troubling side prevents uncomplicated happiness. The fear belongs to the speaker in this domestic image.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A new opportunity offers welcome comforts, but one condition makes the person considering it deeply uneasy. A reader uses the couplet to describe that mixture of attraction and apprehension.
cultural_context: The paired bodily expressions carry the contrast: a full belly suggests contentment, while a spirit taking flight expresses alarm. ସଉତୁଣୀ names a woman sharing the same husband. Her appearance changes the speaker’s response within this verse.

english_summary: An appealing situation also has a side that causes alarm.
